From limited-edition drinkware to gifts for hosts, athletes, and everyone in between, Stanley 1913's holiday gift guide makes checking off the list easy. This season brings new additions across its hydrate and café collections, including the Holiday Collection in Wintergreen Peppermint Stripe and Salt Gingerbread, the Flowstate Spring Water Bottle, Reserve Wine Tumbler, and the brand's first-ever Steel Cooler. entry.content:
Hitch it up, unpack camp, and drive away for a day trip. MyGlamper's Pro mounts on a tow hitch, packs into a shell about 55 inches long, and inflates into a camp that sleeps as many as 12, no trailer wheels required. Setup runs under six minutes, and the vehicle is free to head off once camp stands. It comes stocked with a gas kitchen with three burners, a queen-size air bed, a shower, a composting toilet and an eight-gallon water tank.

entry.content:
Swatch has tied the release of this MoonSwatch to the Swiss weather, and once launch day passes it can be bought only while snow falls in Switzerland. The watch is matte black bioceramic from case to dial, with silver moons on the moon phase, one engraved with a laser snowflake picked from millions of patterns so no two watches match. Snoopy and Woodstock sit below the earth phase, admiring a globe with Switzerland marked in snowy white. Two tiny skis mark 11 o'clock as a nod to the Apollo 11 anniversary Speedmaster, and hidden text appears under a lume torch.

entry.title: 1970 Mercedes-Benz C 111-II Prototype Sports Car
entry.summary: In 1969, Mercedes-Benz refused to sell its C 111, even to buyers offering blank checks, and again refused when the C 111-II arrived months later. This C 111-II has gullwing doors and a mid-mounted four-rotor rotary engine that makes 350 horsepower and revs to 9,000 rpm. Metallic
entry.content:
In 1969, Mercedes-Benz refused to sell its C 111, even to buyers offering blank checks, and again refused when the C 111-II arrived months later. This C 111-II has gullwing doors and a mid-mounted four-rotor rotary engine that makes 350 horsepower and revs to 9,000 rpm. Metallic orange paint covers the body, and the interior is trimmed with houndstooth. Chassis 33 appeared in Playboy's first German issue, and Herbert von Karajan, who conducted the Berlin Philharmonic, drove it. After almost 20 years on display at the company museum, Mercedes F1 driver George Russell drove it into Silverstone for a practice day. The car is now up for auction, the first C 111 a private buyer can bid on.

entry.summary: Inspired by the character of the British countryside, REISS' Fall 2026 menswear collection brings a modern edge to heritage dressing. Standout pieces include the tobacco-brown Bodrum distressed shearling aviator jacket, Kingsley speckled wool overshirt, Vatali open-collar wool-co
entry.content:
Inspired by the character of the British countryside, REISS' Fall 2026 menswear collection brings a modern edge to heritage dressing. Standout pieces include the tobacco-brown Bodrum distressed shearling aviator jacket, Kingsley speckled wool overshirt, Vatali open-collar wool-cotton jumper, Tuscan houndstooth blazer, and Deal wool pinstripe trousers. Rich textures, traditional fabrics, and a palette of warm neutrals, earthy browns, and deep berry tones give the collection its seasonal character, balancing relaxed layering with considered tailoring. The result is a versatile wardrobe that moves effortlessly between country escapes and city streets.

entry.title: Milwaukee Boot Co. x Wandawega Centennial Collection
entry.summary: Milwaukee Boot Co. and Camp Wandawega bring two Wisconsin legacies together for a limited-edition collection celebrating 100 years of camp culture and four generations of family shoemaking. At the center is the men's Camp Boot, featuring a premium leather upper, Goodyear welt con
entry.content:
Milwaukee Boot Co. and Camp Wandawega bring two Wisconsin legacies together for a limited-edition collection celebrating 100 years of camp culture and four generations of family shoemaking. At the center is the men's Camp Boot, featuring a premium leather upper, Goodyear welt construction, a rugged Vibram outsole, distinctive red accents, and a removable boot kilt inspired by Wandawega's nostalgic outdoor aesthetic. Built to be resoled and backed by a lifetime guarantee, it's joined by a trio of complementary leather goods: the Field Issue Utility Bag, Retreat Duffel, and Lake View Toiletry Bag. With heritage-inspired hardware, thoughtful details, and craftsmanship designed to outlast trends, the collection makes a strong case for buying fewer, better things.
